obstacles_or_notes: The boards stand in a line. One shelf stands between source and relay; the same shelf is also between source and sink. Nothing was moved during the runs. Source TX power index 1, relay and sink 10.
supply: USB (VBAT about 5 V as reported by the modem)
serial_bridge: Source and relay UARTs were reached through a TCP-to-serial bridge on a separate computer (script not included); the sink was on a local COM port.
_note: Layout used for data/E1_outage_sweep_v2 (Oct 12 to 13, 2026). Distances are rough estimates (not measured with a tape). Run manifests of those runs were written before this file existed and do not contain it.
